invalid_if: The exclusivity binds a person who is not a party
name: Exclusivity
title: Exclusivity
text:
This provision is a Binding Provision.
(a) The "Exclusivity Period" begins on the date of this Term Sheet and ends on the earliest of: the end of {{exclusivity_period}} from that date; the execution of the Definitive Agreements; and the date on which the Investor notifies the Company in writing that it does not wish to proceed.
(b) During the Exclusivity Period, the Company and each Founder shall not, directly or indirectly, solicit, encourage, negotiate or accept any proposal from any person other than the Investor for an investment in the Company, or for the acquisition of shares in, or of all or substantially all of the assets of, the Company.
(c) The Company shall promptly inform the Investor if it or any Founder receives such a proposal during the Exclusivity Period.

legal_basis.note: Agreements in restraint of trade are void; a short, definite exclusivity in a negotiation restrains dealing rather than trade, but the period must be reasonable
Compensation for loss caused by breach

authoring_note: Binds the Company and each Founder, all of whom are parties and sign. The old clause bound 'the Founders', who were not parties to the old term sheet and signed nothing. The period comes from the user; periods over 90 days are flagged as unusual and over 180 days for review.
d4_44: Rebuilt 9 Oct 2026. Non-binding provisions are drafted as proposals ('it is proposed that ... be'), never as obligations, so the wording agrees with the Status provision.
